method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seats of the individuals to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the rules in one module, each seat's questions in its own module importing it; two regulative rules (s 33ZG, s 33ZA(3)(c)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seats: the group member: a person with a claim who is, or may be, a member of the group in a group proceeding (class action) in the Supreme Court of Victoria (gp-seat.l4)
the representative plaintiff: the person with a claim who commences the group proceeding as representative party, or is substituted as plaintiff (gp-seat-plaintiff.l4)
